reply_text:
I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes and sent them to you in our direct message. I only checked notes you can see yourself.

1. #PD-4492 is in "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers on the 04:00 shift at Dock Doors 14–18 in the Eau Claire yard weren't getting their bay assignments by text at gatehouse check-in. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed the next morning's shift got through without manual help.

2. #4419 is in "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. The note says it went to tier-2 product support for scanner firmware testing. It has no date and doesn't say whether the ticket was resolved.

Left out, and why:
- #4409 and #4412 in the Central handoffs digest (2026-01-02) belong to Marrow Fieldworks, not Quarrendon.
- FR-882 belongs to Marrow Agrisupply.
- Moss's other two Quarrendon notes, the 2025-09-14 North pipeline digest and the 2026-03-23 renewal check-in, have no ticket numbers.
- Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways" is about a different company that isn't a customer.

There's a Quarrendon incident channel you're not in, so I didn't look there. If you need every ticket, ask Ilse or Dana on the North team.
